newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP's Pfeiffer named to head GAN - Le Monde.
newsitem.headline: UAP's Pfeiffer named to head GAN - Le Monde.

text.p: French afternoon daily Le Monde said on Wednesday the finance ministry had confirmed to it that UAP vice-president Didier Pfeiffer had been picked as the government's choice to head state-owned insurer GAN.
The government adopted a decree on Wednesday morning firing Jean-Jacques Bonnaud from his job as chairman of GAN after Bonnaud resisted a call to resign.
The finance ministry was not immediately able to confirm the nomination, which finance minister Jean Arthuis is due to announce formally later in the day.
Arthuis called off a tender for the privatisation of GAN's CIC banking subsidiary earlier this month and said both Bonnaud and CIC chairman Bernard Youncourt had failed to promote the sell-off.
Bonnaud's replacement is expected to name a successor for Youncourt.
Bonnaud issued a statement on Wednesday saying he hoped that the integrity of his group would be preserved in the wake of his departure.
GAN itself is a privatisation candidate but the government opted to sell off CIC first.
